eligibility_rule: project-disjoint splits: a defect whose project is assigned to ablation_dev, val, or test can never enter training, so it is not part of the ceiling however many such defects exist

bugsinpy.ingestion_path: native WSL2 execution (the pilot reproduces 3 of 5)

swebench_ingestion.reason: The SWE-bench path runs the official harness on Modal. No Modal token is configured, so those instances cannot be reproduced or verified here.

bugsinpy_project_concentration.note: Most of the un-ingested BugsInPy supply is one project. Ingesting it wholesale would fix the count while making the project-concentration problem worse, which the balancing policy explicitly forbids.

conclusion: The 50/50 unique-target balance is NOT reachable from the data currently available under the project-disjointness rule. The balanced-dataset manifest reports this as a blocking condition rather than manufacturing the ratio by deleting synthetic targets or repeating repository ones.
